assurance: Every training best viable snapshot and every positive patch independently checked; every actual main search tree checked; every bank template and all12images audited; first/last selected cluster proposals perrun audited. Unknown/checker resource stops do not become negative.
clusters: Eight prior automatically found checked marked-corona expansions; add normalized length8..12 windows stride4 from independently positive training patches, max32templates. Each proposal validates aggregate t/m plus parent interface; only current branch anchor is ordered first, with all base candidates retained. No macro or sequence execution.
comparisons: Five marked lanes solve one fixed learned restricted model; unmarked lexical lane is a separate baseline, not a claim that learned marks preserve all unmarked solutions.
costs: Full training/preparation/validation/recording/evaluation costs timed. Parent200.096s marking/corona acquisition is reused, not rerun or hidden; no complete cold speedup claim from search-only timings.
learning: Stochastic linear-softmax REINFORCE from verified episode reward; evaluate deterministic argmax with bank/weights frozen before any heldout search
recording: Per-run immutable gzip records compressionlevel1; compact final index with byte/hash references. All raw search returns retained before assurance.
region_semantics: Every listed core point, including untouched zeros, is an explicit generation0 obligation; all seed support included. New positive support activates too. Exterior unconstrained by target geometry; every exposed frontier must be viable at finite checkpoint. No continuous polygon-region coverage claim.
training_order: Episode e uses training case e modulo8; deterministic distinct episode RNGseed
